title: fleet_backup_pull.py config-backup manifest (manifest.json)
description: Persisted at <root>/<product>/<serial>/<machine-id>/manifest.json, atomic write (tools/fleet_backup_pull.py::save_manifest). The record of what the machine folder holds and the incremental cursor. An unreadable file, or a schema_version other than 1, is rebuilt from the _versions/**/*.bak filenames on disk (rebuild_manifest_from_disk) rather than failing the run.

product.description: which product tree this machine folder lives under

instrument_serial.description: the PicoQuant instrument's serial, or the literal "unknown" — the <serial> path segment

machine_id.description: the v2 agent's machine identifier — the <machine-id> path segment; always present, all-zero-GUID fallback

updated_utc.description: when the last run that touched this folder finished

artifacts.description: every archived version of every watched file for this machine, any order

id.description: backend backup id — the dedupe key. Null only for an entry reconstructed by rebuild_manifest_from_disk, which cannot recover it from a .bak filename alone; such entries fall back to (rel_path, content_sha256) as the dedupe key until the next clean manifest write restores real ids.

file_key.description: the v2 agent's logical file identifier for this watched file (contracts/backend-admin-api.md)

source_path.description: original Windows path as reported by the v2 agent, verbatim

rel_path.description: rel(source_path) — where this file's current/newest copy lives in the archive tree, drive letter stripped, backslashes normalised to forward slashes

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the downloaded bytes, verified against the backend row's own content_sha256 at download time

received_at.description: when the backend received this version from the v2 agent — the ordering key across versions of the same file, and part of the _versions/*.bak filename

file_mtime.description: the watched file's own filesystem mtime on the source machine, if the agent reported one; carried through for a future restore's own change-detection

agent_version.description: the v2 agent version that produced this backup submission; informational only

version_file.description: POSIX path of this version's _versions/**/*.bak file, relative to the machine folder

is_latest.description: true for the newest received_at of this file_key/rel_path — the one also mirrored at rel_path itself outside _versions/

archived_utc.description: when this archive run wrote this entry — distinct from received_at (when the backend got it from the agent) and from file_mtime (the source file's own mtime); three different clocks
